### 1. Architecture Overview
Prometheus’ new `AppenderV2` collapses all sample/histogram/exemplar/metadata/start-timestamp writes into one `Append(ref, ls, st, t, v, h, fh, opts)` call plus `AppenderTransaction`. Across the ecosystems:
- **Thanos** Receive ingest path wraps/uses `storage.Appender` directly to push samples/histograms/exemplars for tenant TSDBs.
- **Mimir** has a mix: the OTLP distributor appender is already V2, but ruler/block-builder paths still implement/consume V1 appenders.
- **Loki** ruler uses custom V1 appenders and a V2 adapter around them in the WAL storage.
- **Tempo** metrics generator wires Prometheus’ fanout storage (V1 Appendable) for per-tenant WAL/remote-write.
- **OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib** Prometheus receiver exports metrics by implementing `storage.Appendable` and a V1-style transaction (`Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendExemplar`, metadata) per scrape.

All of these V1 implementations/wrappers/consumers must be migrated to `AppenderV2` (or deleted in favor of the LimitedAppenderV1 shim) except the Mimir OTLP appender which is already on V2.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Thanos**
  - `pkg/receive/writer.go`: `ReceiveAppender` wraps `storage.Appender` and `Writer.Write` calls `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendExemplar`, `Commit` on the returned appender (lines 40-166). Needs to call V2 `Append` once (with hist/exemplar/metadata/start-timestamp via `AppendV2Options`) and handle `Commit/Rollback` on `AppenderTransaction`.
  - `pkg/receive/capnproto_writer.go`: Same ingestion path for Cap’n Proto input; uses `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendExemplar`, `Commit` on a `storage.Appender` (lines 43-147). Must migrate to V2 call and transaction semantics.

- **Mimir**
  - **Already V2:** `pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go` implements `Append(ref, ls, ct, t, v, h, fh, opts storage.AppendV2Options)` and handles exemplars/metadata/start timestamps (lines 59-179) — no change needed.
  - **Still V1:**
    - `pkg/ruler/compat.go`: `PusherAppender` implements V1 methods `Append`, `AppendExemplar`, `UpdateMetadata`, `AppendHistogram*`, `SetOptions`, `Commit/Rollback` (lines 44-104). Must convert to `AppenderV2` (and possibly `AppenderTransaction` if batching is needed).
    - `pkg/blockbuilder/tsdb.go`: Ingest path uses `extendedAppender` from `db.Appender(ctx)` and calls V1 methods `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendHistogramSTZeroSample/CTZeroSample`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, then `Commit/Rollback` (lines 105-259). Needs to switch to the unified `Append` with `AppendV2Options.StartTimestamp`/`Exemplars` and transaction lifecycle.

- **Loki**
  - `pkg/ruler/base/compat.go`: `PusherAppender` implements V1 `storage.Appender` (`Append`, `AppendExemplar`, `UpdateMetadata`, `AppendHistogram*`, `SetOptions`, `Commit/Rollback`) (lines 44-104). Must migrate to `AppenderV2`.
  - `pkg/ruler/storage/wal/wal.go`: Custom WAL storage appender implements V1 (`Append`, `AppendExemplar`, `UpdateMetadata`, `AppendHistogram*`) (lines 591-705) and is wrapped by an `appenderV2Adapter` (lines 336-365) that adapts V1 to V2. When V1 is removed, this adapter and underlying V1 appender must be rewritten to implement `AppenderV2` directly (or replaced by LimitedAppenderV1 until removed).

- **Tempo**
  - `modules/generator/storage/instance.go`: `storageImpl` exposes `Appender(ctx) storage.Appender` returning Prometheus `storage.NewFanout(...)` (V1) (lines 141-144). Must return `AppenderV2`/`AppenderTransaction` and use the new API in the fanout/WAL wiring.
  - (Tests) `modules/generator/registry/appender_test.go` contains test appenders for V1; should be updated alongside production changes.

- **OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib**
  - `receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/appendable.go`: Implements `storage.Appendable` returning a transaction implementing V1 Appender (line 50-52). Must return `AppenderTransaction`/`AppenderV2`.
  - `receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go`: Transaction implements V1 methods `Append` (samples), `AppendHistogram`, plus start-timestamp helpers (`AppendSTZeroSample`), exemplars, metadata, commit/rollback (lines 100-352, 355-360). Needs to consolidate into the new `AppendV2` signature (with `AppendV2Options` for exemplars/metadata/start timestamps) and implement `AppenderTransaction`.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| thanos | pkg/receive/writer.go | `ReceiveAppender` wraps `storage.Appender`; `Writer.Write` calls V1 `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendExemplar`, `Commit` (lines 40-166) – must migrate to `AppenderV2`/transaction. |
| thanos | pkg/receive/capnproto_writer.go | Cap’n Proto ingest uses V1 `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendExemplar`, `Commit` (lines 43-147) – needs V2 `Append`. |
| mimir | pkg/distributor/otlpappender/mimir_appender.go | Already implements `Append(ref, ls, ct, t, v, h, fh, opts storage.AppendV2Options)` (lines 59-179) – confirm V2-compliant, no change. |
| mimir | pkg/ruler/compat.go | `PusherAppender` implements V1 (`Append`, `AppendExemplar`, `UpdateMetadata`, `AppendHistogram*`, `SetOptions`, `Commit/Rollback`) (lines 44-104) – must move to `AppenderV2`. |
| mimir | pkg/blockbuilder/tsdb.go | Ingestion uses V1 appender methods `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, `AppendHistogramSTZeroSample`, `AppendSTZeroSample`, `Commit` (lines 105-259) – needs unified V2 `Append` with `AppendV2Options`. |
| loki | pkg/ruler/base/compat.go | `PusherAppender` implements V1 `storage.Appender` (lines 44-104) – migrate to `AppenderV2`. |
| loki | pkg/ruler/storage/wal/wal.go | Custom WAL `appender` implements V1 methods (lines 591-705); wrapped by `appenderV2Adapter` (lines 336-365). Underlying appender must be rewritten to native `AppenderV2` (adapter removable once V1 gone). |
| tempo | modules/generator/storage/instance.go | `storageImpl.Appender(ctx) storage.Appender` returns Prometheus fanout (V1) (lines 141-144); needs to expose `AppenderV2`/transaction and update wiring. |
| tempo (tests) | modules/generator/registry/appender_test.go | Test appenders implement V1; should be updated alongside production interface change. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/appendable.go | Implements `storage.Appendable` returning V1 transaction (line 50-52) – must return `AppenderTransaction`/`AppenderV2`. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/prometheusreceiver/internal/transaction.go | V1 transaction implements `Append`, `AppendHistogram`, start-timestamp helpers, exemplars/metadata, commit/rollback (lines 100-352, 355-360) – needs single V2 `Append` with `AppendV2Options` and transaction API. |

These are the custom appenders/wrappers/consumers across Thanos, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib that need to be aligned with Prometheus `AppenderV2` (or explicitly use the LimitedAppenderV1 shim until full migration).
